item.title: Guía del votante del Isthmus Elecciones Primarias Primavera 2026
item.description: Una carrera para el Tribunal del Circuito del Condado de Dane y tres carreras para la Mesa Directiva del Condado de Dane tendrán primarias el 17 de febrero.

item.title: Spring 2026 Primary Isthmus voter guide
item.description: A Dane County circuit court race and three Dane County board seats have primaries on Feb. 17.

item.title: DeForest announces it won’t move forward with controversial $12 billion data center
item.description: The Madison suburb of DeForest, where a $12 billion data center proposal has been in development for months, abruptly announced Jan. 27 that the data center “is not feasible.”

item.title: What to do in Madison this weekend: Wisconsin Chamber Orchestra, Digable Planets and more Isthmus Picks
item.description: Picks for Jan. 29-Feb. 1 also includes a tribute to Brian Wilson by Austin Cebulske Quintet; Forward Theater presents the Wisconsin premiere of 'Ironbound.

item.title: Disclaimer missing on likely AI-generated Tom Tiffany campaign ad
item.description: Though a campaign ad for gubernatorial candidate Tom Tiffany contains irregularities that ‘point toward an AI-generated video,’ the ad contains no disclaimer, as is required by Wisconsin state law.

item.title: What to do in Madison this week: Step Afrika, Winter Carnival and more Isthmus Picks
item.description: Picks for Feb. 2-5 also includes the return of an annual Madison College SOUL Affinity Group exhibit honoring the stories of Black women; 'A Love Letter' is a collaboration by Theatre LILA and Barrio Dance.

item.title: Forward Theater’s ‘Ironbound’ is painfully current
item.description: ‘Ironbound’ is a meditation on love, endurance, and survival in a system designed to exploit those with the least power.

item.title: Retention bonus did not retain Jennifer Mnookin
item.description: Last June UW-Madison Chancellor Jennifer Mnookin received a retention bonus of $150,000. She would have gotten $250,000 had she stayed into June of this year, but instead she’s leaving for Columbia University.

item.title: A new book chronicles the history of Wisconsin’s iconic Birkebeiner
item.description: Jerome Poling covers the cross country race from its origins to its weather-plagued present.

item.title: Madison Opera’s premiere of ‘Everlasting Faint’ engages with history — and the present moment
item.description: An opera about 19th century ghosts and moms taking down the patriarchy couldn’t be more relevant.
